text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Canary health alert: inference-canary (us-east-1) experiencing repeated CrashLoopBackOffs and rapid HPA scaling. Crashloops > 5 in last 90s. Triggered by deploy v4.2.1. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/canary-crash

Priya (oncall): ack, I'm paged. Looking now. Can someone post `kubectl get pods` output? I'm attaching logs + will check metrics.

Zach (infra): grabbing events. Quick summary: new manifest introduced `readinessProbe` path `/healthz/v2` (previously `/healthz`) and an HPA change set `minReplicas: 0`. Pods failing readiness -> HPA sees low CPU -> weird oscillation. Also seeing a bunch of preStop hooks stuck on Terminating during node drain. `kubectl describe pod inference-canary-*` shows TerminationGracePeriodWait.

Priya (oncall): ok that explains the loop. If readiness path is wrong, traffic still sent and app tries to load models -> OOM/crash.

Emily (release): that readiness change was in the canary-only manifest for v4.2.1. We also flipped feature flag `canary_lazy_kv` in the release which changes model warmup order. Might be combining badly.

Olivia (support): FYI a few customers reported elevated 500s for short windows. Support ticket #INC-2451 from acme-corp about 503 spikes between 14:02-14:09 UTC.

Priya (oncall): immediate mitigation: 1) Pause rollout / stop routing to canary 2) Kill the new feature flag for canary 3) If still noisy, rollback the deployment. Who can flip the flag? @Emily?

Emily (release): I can flip the flag. Hitting the internal flags API now.

Emily (release): POST /flags/toggle

```\ncurl -X POST "https://flags.internal/api/toggle" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLAGS_TOKEN" \\n  -d '{"flag":"canary_lazy_kv","env":"us-east-1","value":false}'\n```

Emily (release): flag toggled -> :white_check_mark: Seeing fewer model loads but pods still stuck in restart cycle because readiness never becomes healthy on previously failed pods.

Zach (infra): we should cordon the nodes with the evicted pods to prevent further drains from interfering. Also set HPA minReplicas to 1 for canary. Running commands now:

```\nkubectl patch hpa inference-canary -n inference -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 1}}'\nkubectl get pod -n inference -l app=inference-canary -o wide\nkubectl logs -n inference -l app=inference-canary --tail=200\n```

Priya (oncall): logs show OOM on model init: `java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space` (for the JVM wrapper). Looks like resource limits got lowered in v4.2.1 too. Can we scale replicas to reduce memory pressure while we rollback?

Mike (sre): I'll start a controlled rollback of the canary deployment to v4.2.0 and pause the canary routing. Deploy-bot, can you run the rollback? @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: Rollback requested by Mike (sre). Starting `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-canary --to-revision=42` in namespace inference. This may take up to 3 minutes. Link: https://deploys.internal/rollouts/9876

Priya (oncall): good. I'll watch metrics and check error rates on the hosted API route that was using the canary.

Olivia (support): customer-facing note: Acme-corp saw 5-10% increased 500s; most traffic hit fallback model and retried successfully. No data loss reported. I'm posting a brief to the customers impacted channel.

Zach (infra): rollback completed. `kubectl rollout status deployment/inference-canary -n inference`: success. Pods stable at 3 replicas, readiness green.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Rollback to revision 42 complete. Canary routing paused. Notifying load-balancer to stop sending test traffic to inference-canary.

Mike (sre): Confirming: error rate on API route down to baseline (1xx -> 2xx). HPA now stable at minReplicas=2. I'll keep an eye for 15m.

Priya (oncall): Good containment. Immediate root causes we think: 1) bad readinessProbe path in canary manifest 2) resource limit reduction in v4.2.1 3) feature flag change increased memory pressure during model warmup 4) HPA minReplicas set to 0 allowed scale-to-zero which worsened restart storms during drain.

Emily (release): taking action items: revert the readiness path change, revert resource limit changes in canary, and add a gate to prevent `minReplicas: 0` for inference HPAs. Also we will add a flag rollout gradual ramp and add canary-specific post-deploy checks for readiness path.

Olivia (support): customer impact note ready. I'll update INC-2451 with timeline and mitigation steps and ping customers who saw spikes.

Priya (oncall): Handoff: I'm on for another 30m and will monitor. After that I'll hand to Mike for postmortem and follow-up with release. Assigning postmortem to Emily + Mike. Please include reproducer steps and the exact manifest diff. :memo:

Mike (sre): Took over monitoring at 14:30 UTC. Will open a postmortem doc and schedule a blameless review. Tentative sev: sev2 (partial service degradation for a subset of traffic).

Priya (oncall): thanks all. Closing the active pager. If anything bubbles up ping #incidents. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Pager resolved (closed by Priya). Incident summary link: https://incidents.internal/1969103210/summary
